result.description: Night Orchard Aster Loom EP02 is a fictional experimental audio release designed as a looping ambient cassette rather than a computer storage or graphics product. It features slowly shifting analog textures, field-recorded wind tones, and layered tape hiss intended for late-night listening, installation art, and meditation spaces. The release is presented in a compact collectible tape format with a hand-numbered sleeve and no digital download code.
result.title: Aster Loom EP02 Ambient Soundscape Cassette
